mechanisms.text: Two metric tracks: automated metrics (Recall, NDCG) computed via compute_auto_metrics_for_realmem.py, and LLM-based qualitative metrics computed via compute_llm_metrics_for_realmem.py with a configurable judge model (default gpt-4o).
Pipeline transforms high-level project outlines into granular multi-turn dialogues via modular stages: project outline, event sequence, session summary, and multi-agent dialogue generation.
Dataset comprises over 2,000 cross-session dialogues spanning eleven scenarios, using natural user queries for evaluation.
LLM-as-judge uses a configurable evaluator model defaulting to gpt-4o.

ledger.claim: Primary automated metrics are Recall and NDCG over retrieved memory points.
ledger.quote: We support both automated metrics (Recall, NDCG) and LLM-based qualitative metrics.
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: LLM-as-judge is used for qualitative metrics with gpt-4o as the default judge model.
ledger.quote: --model_name : Model used as the evaluator/judge (default: gpt-4o).
ledger.locator: README.md, Metrics Calculation / LLM-based Metrics section
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Default retrieval k in the evaluation pipeline pseudocode is 10; default top_k for generation is 5.
ledger.quote: memories = self.retrieve_memories(question, keywords, k=10) ... --top_k : Number of top retrieved memories to use (default: 5).
ledger.locator: README.md, Evaluation Pipeline Logic and Response Generation sections
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Dataset is synthetically generated by the multi-agent pipeline (not human-annotated), with personas drawn from persona_all.json.
ledger.quote: python main.py --names 'Lin Wanyu' --smart-recovery ... See dataset/all_persona_topic/persona_all.json for available names
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Each dataset file is named after a persona and contains up to 256k tokens of dialogue (inferred from example filename).
ledger.quote: each corresponding to a distinct user persona (e.g., Adeleke_Okonjo_dialogues_256k.json)
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Generation pipeline supports configurable number of projects per persona (default 3) and max turns per session (default 24).
ledger.quote: --projects : Number of projects (dialogue topics) to generate per person. Default: 3. --max-turns : Maximum number of turns per dialogue session. Default: 24.
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Separate models can be configured for blueprint, event, summary, dialogue, and memory extraction stages.
ledger.quote: --blueprint-model ... --event-model ... --summary-model ... --dialogue-model ... --memory-model
ledger.locator: README.md, Quick Start / Model Configuration section
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Paper accepted at ACL 2026 Findings; arXiv preprint at arxiv.org/abs/2601.06966.
ledger.quote: Our RealMem is accepted by ACL 2026 Findings! ... We released the paper RealMem on arXiv.
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Primary automated metrics are Recall and NDCG, computed against ground-truth memory annotations in the dataset.
ledger.quote: We support both automated metrics (Recall, NDCG) and LLM-based qualitative metrics.
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: LLM-based evaluation uses gpt-4o as the default judge model via compute_llm_metrics_for_realmem.py.
ledger.quote: --model_name <model> : Model used as the evaluator/judge (default: gpt-4o ).
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Generation model defaults to gpt-4o-mini for producing evaluated responses.
ledger.quote: --model_name <model> : Model used for generation (default: gpt-4o-mini ).
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Retrieval uses top-k=10 during evaluation pipeline and top-k=5 during generation by default.
ledger.quote: memories = self.retrieve_memories(question, keywords, k=10) ... --top_k <num> : Number of top retrieved memories to use (default: 5).
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Dataset is synthetic, generated by a multi-agent pipeline (not human-annotated), with personas drawn from persona_all.json.
ledger.quote: RealMem operates as a modular pipeline, transforming high-level project outlines into granular, multi-turn dialogues.
ledger.label: inferred

ledger.claim: The benchmark was accepted at ACL 2026 Findings and the arXiv paper is arXiv:2601.06966.
ledger.quote: 2026.04.06 🎉 Our RealMem is accepted by ACL 2026 Findings! ... eprint={2601.06966}
ledger.label: inferred

ledger.claim: Evaluation ground truth for retrieval is provided via memory_used annotations in the dataset, enabling computation of Recall and NDCG against known retrieved memory points.
ledger.quote: memory_used : The memory points retrieved and used by the assistant for generating this specific response. (List of objects containing session_uuid and content ).
ledger.label: inferred

ledger.claim: Dialogue generation supports configurable number of projects per persona (default 3) and max turns per session (default 24).
ledger.quote: --projects <num> : Number of projects (dialogue topics) to generate per person. Default: 3. --max-turns <num> : Maximum number of turns per dialogue session. Default: 24.
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Benchmark targets the ability to track long-term project states and dynamic context dependencies.
ledger.quote: current memory systems face significant challenges in managing the long-term project states and dynamic context dependencies inherent in real-world projects.
ledger.label: inferred

ledger.claim: RealMem comprises over 2,000 cross-session dialogues across eleven scenarios.
ledger.quote: RealMem comprises over 2,000 cross-session dialogues across eleven scenarios, utilizing natural user queries for evaluation.
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Dataset statistics: avg. context length 269,190 tokens/user; avg. 205 sessions/user; avg. 6.8 turns/session; 14,028 total dialogue turns; 5,072 total memories; 1,415 total questions.
ledger.quote: Avg. Context Length (tokens / user): 269,190 | Avg. Session Number (per user): 205 | Avg. Turns per Session: 6.8 | Total Dialogue Turns: 14,028 | Total Memories: 5,072 | Total Questions: 1,415
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: QA timing is interleaved within sessions, distinguishing RealMem from benchmarks that query after each or all sessions.
ledger.quote: QA Timing: Interleaved within sessions
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: For long-term project dialogues, NDCG (precision/ranking quality) is more decisive than Recall (coverage) for downstream generation quality.
ledger.quote: for long-term project dialogues, precision and ranking quality (NDCG) are more decisive than mere coverage (Recall). High recall with low precision introduces noise that distracts the LLM, whereas high NDCG ensures that the most relevant context is prioritized, directly translating to better response quality.
ledger.label: inferred

ledger.claim: Human cross-validation shows perfect alignment between automated QA Score ranking and human ranking across four systems.
ledger.quote: the ranking order remains consistent across all evaluated systems (MemoryOS > Graph Memory > A-mem > Mem0), where a decrease in QA score strictly corresponds to a decline in human ranking
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Code Architecture Design is the hardest scenario across all methods; Health Consultation is the most robust.
ledger.quote: Code Architecture Design consistently yields the lowest scores across all methods (e.g., MemoryOS QA: 0.363)... Health Consultation emerges as the most robust scenario (e.g., MemoryOS QA: 0.694)
ledger.label: inferred

ledger.claim: The benchmark tests temporal reasoning, static retrieval, dynamic updating, and proactive alignment as distinct memory abilities.
ledger.quote: Examples of four query types in RealMem: (1) Temporal Reasoning resolves temporal constraints and schedule conflicts; (2) Static Retrieval ensures continuity by recalling accumulated context; (3) Dynamic Updating synchronizes memory with evolving project states; and (4) Proactive Alignment leverages user memory to anticipate implicit intents and goals.
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: RealMem does not currently assess tool use capabilities.
ledger.quote: RealMem currently focuses specifically on memory-centric challenges within long-term project-oriented interactions. Consequently, the benchmark does not yet involve the assessment of tool use capabilities
ledger.label: measured
